_doc: M5-A3P-1808 (act3_roster.md, Ch18 K02): the Kite's gulls, Act I's gull kind riding the Kite's wake as the world opens. The flock's `follow` is the Kite (a node path from the layer), so its centre, perches and birds are in the Kite's space and ride with it: a loose ring astern and above the deck, two birds standing on the stern rail at the start. Review stage kite_gulls.tscn moves a stand-in Kite; the Kite's own scene adds this row to its WildlifeLayer when it exists (follow: its Kite node). Same keys as a zone file; not a zone.
